views_reviewed.method: Viewed complete contact sheet of all 18 captures, plus full-size station high, employee static/idle-start/interact-middle, shopper interact-middle/front and side.

observations: Original station clearly contains a broad dark belt and a compact terminal/display; the model is usable as part of one complete checkout lane.
Both complete characters retain friendly faces, original clothes, hair, skeletons and materials. Green-and-white employee and yellow/purple shopper are visually distinct.
Static clip arms are extended sideways and are less suitable than the selected idle and interact-right samples.
Employee idle-start has relaxed arms. Shopper interact-right at 0.333 seconds extends the right hand naturally forward; it can support presenting purchases when positioned near the belt.
Generic carton and apple source models are recognizable and have no readable credentials or brand wordmarks. Complete original floor tiles may be compared, but are optional composition context.
remaining_checks: The employee must visibly occupy the terminal side and the shopper the goods side.
Verify body/station clearance, both foot positions, hand-to-belt relationship and groceries touching the actual belt.
The terminal must not dominate the whole place; no isolated-register interpretation.
Judge belt, groceries and two roles in actual Match/Memory native-size states, including matched badge and alpha.
The source probe validates selected still poses only, not all 32 animation clips or an animated final asset.
source_changes: None; no mesh/material/texture/skin/child-node edits. Proposed poses use only original included animation clips.
acceptance_scope: Root and author independently inspected the source contact and selected poses. Scoped AI source suitability only; not human review, final image acceptance, or production integration.
root_review: Root confirmed the belt-and-terminal station, friendly/distinct character roles, and usability of the forward interact-middle arm; static T-like arms remain unused. Hand/terminal intersections and role recognition still require actual 102x52 composition review.
